summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for opening_balance_date enforcement, bank transaction date guard, reconciliation administration scoping, data-flow validation, and build gates on public URL.

issues: Date field label requires YYYY/MM/DD, but native input placeholder renders locale format (mm/dd/yyyy) in browser, which may confuse users.

If strict visual format YYYY/MM/DD is mandatory, replace native date input with a controlled formatter/masked input or explicit formatted display helper.

Current transaction-date rejection message is bilingual in one string; requirement wording suggests English-only output may be expected.
